evidence.note: אֶת מְתוּשָׁאֵל identifies the son Mehujael fathers. The next clause repeats the name as its subject, וּמְתוּשָׁאֵל יָלַד אֶת לָמֶךְ, identifying Methushael as Lamech’s father.

name: מְתוּשָׁאֵל
note: The proposed meaning draws on the personal noun and the final divine element. Genesis gives the descent without explaining the name.
summary: In Cain’s genealogy, Mehujael fathers Methushael and Methushael fathers Lamech.
